content.text:
Resubmitted with the payment carve-out repaired in operative language.

**What changed:** the payment carve-out now sits in the operative exception to the cap itself — "Except for Excluded Claims **and Ono's payment obligations under this Agreement, which are excluded from the damages subject to this cap**, each Party's total aggregate liability ... shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Ono ... in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000." This tracks the preferred element wording directly rather than relying on the separate "shall not constitute damages" tail.

**Unchanged:** single insertion of new Section 16.7 after p0733 (numbered to avoid the existing 16.6 Recalls), mutual cap, Excluded Claims list (confidentiality; data protection/security; indemnification under Article 10 and Sections 16.1/16.2; gross negligence; willful misconduct; fraud; IP infringement), Section 16.5 preserved verbatim and mapped as already meeting the mutual indirect/consequential exclusion. Validation returned ok:true with minimality clean, and I flagged in the rationale that, because consideration here is upfront/milestone/royalty rather than "fees", the USD 1,000,000 floor may be the operative figure and should be confirmed commercially.
